parsed.note_claim: The briefcase color change was a post-production edit by Sky News to illustrate a "green budget"; it did not occur live on air.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Jonathan Samuels, a presenter for Sky News, explained on Twitter that it was a creative choice made in editing to align with the voiceover script
parsed.reason: The article confirms Sky News edited the footage to match the narration about a green budget rather than it being a live occurrence.
